**Coaching Note:**

Your rook was on the 7th rank and Black's f7 pawn was pinned by it to the king. When Black's queen moved to g6, you had a back-rank weakness to exploit. By sacrificing your bishop with check (**Bxf7+**), you forced the queen to recapture—then your rook recaptured, winning the queen! Look for pins on the 7th rank; they often hide tactical shots.
